A portable cabin in West Delhi is a factory-built steel-frame structure that arrives ready to use — ideal as a site office, security cabin, or retail unit across Janakpuri, Dwarka, and Rajouri Garden. SAMAN manufactures these cabins on an MS frame with insulated PUF panels and dispatches them direct from our Greater Noida factory, so you avoid months of on-site construction.

We are a direct manufacturer, not a reseller. SAMAN Portable (SAMAN POS India Private Limited) has been serving India since 2009, incorporated in 2019, with an ISO 9001:2015 quality system. This guide explains what drives portable cabin cost, the sizes and build spec we make, how delivery to West Delhi works, and the warranty you get when you buy factory-direct.

What Drives the Cost of a Portable Cabin in West Delhi

There is no single fixed price — your portable cabin cost depends on a handful of clear factors. The biggest are the floor size in feet, the panel type and thickness, and the level of internal fit-out. A bare 8x10 ft security cabin sits at the low end; a fully fitted 20x40 ft cabin office with partitions, electricals, and a toilet sits much higher. For an accurate figure, send us your size and use and we will quote your exact requirement.

The Main Price Factors

  • Floor size (feet): larger footprints use more steel, panels, and labour.
  • Panel type and thickness: ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels cost more than single-skin sheeting but hold temperature far better in Delhi heat.
  • Internal fit-out: partition walls, flooring, windows, doors, and electrical points.
  • Toilet or pantry: plumbing and fittings add to the build.
  • Finish: powder-coated exterior, colour, and branding.
  • Delivery distance: transit from our Greater Noida factory to your West Delhi site.

OWNER FACT NEEDED: confirm whether to publish any indicative per-sq-ft range for West Delhi, or keep enquiry-only.

Need a Portable Cabin in West Delhi?

Tell us your size and use, and we will send a clear quote for your West Delhi site.

Call +91 62009 09435

Sizes and Configurations We Make

SAMAN builds portable cabins for West Delhi in standard and custom sizes. Common footprints run from compact 8x10 ft security and guard cabins up to 20x40 ft cabin offices for larger teams. Each unit can be configured as a single open space or split into multiple rooms with insulated partitions.

Popular Uses in West Delhi

  • Construction site offices for projects in Janakpuri
  • Affordable cabin offices for businesses near Dwarka
  • Retail kiosks and pop-up units in Rajouri Garden
  • Security and guard cabins for commercial complexes
  • Home office or study units where space is tight

Common Add-Ons

  • Internal partition walls for multi-room layouts
  • Vinyl, laminate, or tile flooring
  • Pre-wired electrical points and lighting
  • Windows, doors, and ventilation to suit the use
  • Attached toilet or washroom module

How Our Portable Cabins Are Built

Every SAMAN portable cabin is built on a structural steel frame to IS 2062, the Indian standard for structural steel. Walls and roof use roughly 50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels (40 kg/m³ minimum core density) with a pre-galvanised steel skin, topped with GI roofing. Steel members are powder-coated for a durable, corrosion-resistant finish suited to Delhi's dust, heat, and monsoon.

This panel construction is what keeps a portable cabin cooler in summer and quieter inside than a single-sheet shed. Because the structure is bolted and panelled rather than welded on site, it can also be relocated if your project moves.

Delivery and Installation Across West Delhi

We dispatch portable cabins direct from our Greater Noida factory, which keeps your West Delhi delivery fast and within the same region — a real advantage over suppliers shipping from far away. Standard units typically reach site in about 3–5 days transit; custom or fully fitted cabins take longer to build, generally in the range of 7–21 working days depending on specification.

Default delivery is ₹3,000, with the final figure depending on your exact West Delhi location and access. Our team handles placement and basic setup on a prepared, level site. For most temporary portable cabins, permit requirements are lighter than for permanent construction, but rules vary by locality and use — confirm with your local authority for your site. Factory-built, dry-assembled cabins are also generally not restricted by GRAP construction-ban windows the way wet on-site building is.

Why Buy Factory-Direct from SAMAN

Buying direct from the manufacturer means you deal with the people who build the cabin — clearer specs, honest lead times, and no middleman markup. SAMAN has delivered 500+ projects across India and backs every portable cabin with a clear, written warranty.

What You Get

  • Direct-manufacturer pricing and specs
  • MS frame to IS 2062, ~50 mm PUF panels
  • ISO 9001:2015 quality system
  • Greater Noida factory dispatch to West Delhi
  • 7-day customer-paid return window

Warranty

Every cabin carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 5 years covers the structural frame and base; 1–2 years covers finishing; the 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.

Why Buy Your Portable Cabin Factory-Direct from SAMAN

SAMAN manufactures portable cabins in-house on an IS 2062 steel frame at its Bangalore (Gopasandra 560099) and Greater Noida (201308) units, with 500+ projects delivered. Delivery is Rs 3,000 with 3–5 day transit. Warranty is 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. Call or WhatsApp +91 62009 09435, or send an enquiry, for a size-matched quote. Browse the full portable cabins range or our buy portable cabin page.

FAQs: Portable Cabins in West Delhi


How quickly can you deliver a portable cabin to Janakpuri or Dwarka?


Standard portable cabins typically reach West Delhi sites in about 3–5 days transit from our Greater Noida factory. Custom or fully fitted units take longer to build — generally 7–21 working days depending on size, partitions, and fit-out. Share your requirement and we will give you a firm timeline.


What does a portable cabin in West Delhi cost?


Price depends on floor size, panel thickness, internal fit-out, any toilet or partitions, finish, and delivery distance. A bare security cabin costs far less than a fully fitted cabin office. Send us your size and intended use and we will quote your exact requirement.


Do I need a permit to install a portable cabin in Dwarka or Rajouri Garden?


Temporary portable cabins usually need lighter approvals than permanent buildings, but requirements depend on your locality, the intended use, and how long the cabin stays. Always confirm with your local authority. Factory-built, dry-assembled cabins are generally not restricted during GRAP construction-ban windows.


What sizes of portable cabin do you make?


We build from compact 8x10 ft security and guard cabins up to 20x40 ft cabin offices, plus custom sizes. Any unit can be a single open space or split into rooms with insulated partitions, with optional toilet, electricals, and flooring.


How long does a portable cabin last and what is the warranty?


SAMAN portable cabins carry 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing, with a 20–25 years engineered service life for the structure. With basic maintenance — touch-up coating and gasket care — the cabin stays serviceable for many years in West Delhi conditions.


Can portable cabins handle Delhi's summer heat and monsoon?


Yes. The ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels reduce heat transfer in summer, and the pre-galvanised steel skin with powder-coated frame resists dust and monsoon rain. Add an AC and ventilation for full comfort during peak Delhi summers.

Our West Delhi Service Areas

SAMAN delivers and installs portable cabins throughout West Delhi. Our service areas include Janakpuri, Dwarka, Rajouri Garden, Najafgarh, Tilak Nagar, Punjabi Bagh, and surrounding neighbourhoods. To explore sizes and configurations, see our portable cabin range or ask about a portable cabin office for your team.

Get Your Portable Cabin in West Delhi

Whether you need a site office in Janakpuri, a cabin office near Dwarka, or a retail unit in Rajouri Garden, SAMAN delivers factory-direct portable cabins built on an IS 2062 steel frame with insulated PUF panels — dispatched from our Greater Noida factory and backed by a clear structural warranty.

Ready to Get Started?

Call our team or send an enquiry for a quote tailored to your West Delhi site.

Call +91 62009 09435   WhatsApp +91 62009 09435
